item.title: Habitat Network — Coastal Vegetated Shingle source files
item.subtitle: Biodiversity & Habitats / Ulster Wildlife
item.description: Spatial extent of coastal vegetated shingle habitat across Northern Ireland, classified into Existing Habitat, Associated Habitats, Network Enhancement Zones, Fragmentation Action Zones and Network Expansion Zones. Part of the Nature Recovery NI habitat-network mapping project published by Ulster Wildlife on Open Data NI.

references.label: Open Data NI — Coastal Vegetated Shingle Habitat Network
